notes: Owner: *"shouldn't to fan out or not fan out be a switch in the selector line?"* Yes. Two changes: - The fan switch. An overlay whose container carries per-period dispersion now offers fan: off | p10–p90 | p5–p95 directly on its row in the Active overlays list (fan_available rides the resolve payload — offered only where width is actually stated, never invented). Flipping it draws the band around the base line — same axis, same color, thin edges — by fetching the ref's own :pNN variants, so the chart and the resolver cannot disagree about what a fan is. Persisted with the layout; raw view only
